findings.finding: One orientation Mon/Thu and the reverse Tue/Fri has no exact 7-night return on any of the six Moscow pairs.
findings.counterexample: ZIA>AER Mon 2027-08-02; AER>ZIA Tue/Fri only; no return Mon 2027-08-09.
findings.remedy: Two Moscow working tails: both orientations Mon/Thu AER-VOG; Tue/Fri GSV-MRV.

findings.remedy: Stress templates explicitly retime following legs; new slots and sales times remain unaccepted.

findings.finding: 8h/day filter fails some OMS round trips; 10h/day has no hard errors in this bounded sample. Neither is crew approval.
At x1.2 OMS-ZIA and OMS-DME round-trip duty proxy is 725min (12h05); above chosen 12h screening marker. No legal FTL verdict.
findings.remedy: Actual report/release, RPP, rests and roster required; retime or explicit crew relief only after costing.

findings.finding: 7 ready supports the constructed 12-pair 3RT/week programme with 3 OMS working +1 OMS standby. 8 is not a derived minimum for 12 pairs.
findings.remedy: 8-ready example has 4 OMS working +1 standby and increases OMS-Moscow and OMS-IKT to5RT/week. Demand and financing UNKNOWN.
